data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements leiht 'help' and heri 'army' or 'warrior'. Lienhard was a popular name among the Germanic peoples, particularly among those who served in the army. The name was also borne by several saints, including St. Lienhard of Munster, who was known for his bravery and devotion to God.
